profile_text.body:
Salesforce, a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, operates the Slack AI product page at slack.com/features/ai. The page describes Slack AI as a tool that summarizes channels and threads, provides daily recaps, searches files, takes meeting notes, translates conversations, and automates workflows. It also describes Slackbot as a personal AI agent that understands the user and workspace, helps prepare for meetings, analyzes reports, and creates project briefs. The page states that Slack is the conversational UI for Agentforce, and agents built with Agentforce can run directly in Slack channels, threads, and DMs. On security, the page states that customer data is not used to train LLMs, LLM providers do not have access to customer data, and LLMs are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud.

Salesforce's AI products include Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack AI is embedded in messaging and has message-corpus exposure. Tableau AI (Einstein) is described as BI embedded AI with natural language queries, CRM data integration, and Trust Layer governance. Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce is CRM-embedded AI plus agents. Six MCP servers are associated with Salesforce for administration and SOQL queries, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops.

Salesforce is a public company with ticker CRM. Its most recent revenue was $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026, reported on Form 10-K. California legal exposure records list 281 entries for Salesforce, with no individual cases listed.
